This forms a conditional probability distribution P(R|S), which can be modeled as a Bayesian update over belief states. The second operator 'Operant Bar Pressing Behavior' describes a learned motor act triggered by a specific sensory cue, forming a feedback loop: B → V → F. The third operator 'Auditory Cue Conditional Learning' models how temporal correlation between C and reward leads to behavioral adaptation. These operators form a dual structure: one of associative memory (conditioning), another of action-perception coupling (bar pressing). Failure modes include extinction when S is decoupled from reward, or generalization errors when C is misattributed. The system exhibits non-linear dynamics under varying reinforcement schedules, leading to potential bifurcations in behavior.
